DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昨日の届け出についてのご用件ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about yesterday's report, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: なくした釣り道具の届け出で、持ち主の欄を直したいです。実は店から借りていた物でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既存の遺失届けの所有者情報を直したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to correct the owner section in my report of lost fishing equipment. It was actually borrowed from a shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to correct ownership information in an existing lost-property report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付番号と、借りた時の書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the reference number and the borrowing documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号です。貸出表に店の名前と管理番号があります。私の道具だと話してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付番号と貸出表を示し誤った所有説明を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the number. The loan sheet has the shop name and management number. I mistakenly said the equipment was mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the reference number and loan sheet and correct the mistaken ownership statement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 所有者についての情報を担当が確認します。店には紛失したことを伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check the ownership information. Have you told the shop it was lost?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 伝えました。保険に入っているから、この届け出だけで弁償なしになるのか聞かれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店への連絡済みと保険弁償の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have. They asked whether, since it is insured, this report alone means I would not have to pay compensation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you informed the shop and ask about insurance and compensation handling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保険や貸出契約の扱いは、店と保険の担当へご確認ください。こちらでは決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check insurance and rental-contract matters with the shop and insurance staff. We cannot decide that here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。店には、所有者の情報を直す相談に来たことと、受付番号を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保険は別担当と理解し店への報告内容を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will tell the shop I came to consult about correcting the owner information and give the reference number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand insurance is handled separately and decide what to report to the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理番号も用紙へお書きください。道具の特徴を追加する資料として担当へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please write the management number on the form too. We will give it to the staff as additional identifying information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 貸出表の番号を書きました。所有者は店、借りて使っていたのは私という形で、記録を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 貸出管理番号を記入し店と借主を分けて訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written the loan sheet's number. I want the record corrected to show the shop as owner and me as the borrower who used it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Enter the rental management number and distinguish the shop from the borrower in the correction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書類を持って担当席へどうぞ。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take the documents to the staff desk. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便のお受け取りについてでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週から十日ほど家を空けます。郵便受けがいっぱいになりそうで、配達を止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長期不在中の郵便保管を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will be away for about ten days from next week. The mailbox may fill up, so I want deliveries stopped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult about holding mail during a long absence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不在中の保管について受付担当が確認します。不在の期間はいつからですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Reception staff will check about holding it. When does your absence start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 月曜から翌週の水曜までです。帰宅するのは水曜の夜です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不在期間と帰宅時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: From Monday through the following Wednesday. I will be home Wednesday night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the absence period and time you return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご住所と、本人確認の書類をご用意いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you prepare your address and identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所はこちらです。免許証を持ってきました。木曜からまた配達してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所本人確認書類と再開希望日を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the address. I brought my driver's license. I would like deliveries to resume on Thursday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show address and identification and state the desired resumption date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 期間の書き方を担当がご案内します。ご家族の郵便もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will explain how to enter the period. Do you also receive mail for family members?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人暮らしです。宅配便も全部ここで止められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 世帯状況を答え宅配便も対象か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I live alone. Can all courier parcels be stopped here too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your household situation and ask whether courier parcels are included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 他社の配達は別にご相談ください。こちらで扱う郵便の範囲も担当が説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consult other companies separately about their deliveries. The staff will explain the scope of mail handled here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、この住所への郵便の保管を申し込みます。他社の荷物は配送会社へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 郵便保管を申し込み他社への連絡を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will apply to hold the mail for this address. I will contact the courier companies about their parcels.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Apply for mail holding and decide to contact other delivery companies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの受付へどうぞ。ご旅行、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to this reception desk. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードについてのお問い合わせですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about a card, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布を取られたかもしれません。銀行のカードをすぐ止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 盗難の疑いと緊急停止を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My wallet may have been stolen. I want to stop my bank card immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report suspected theft and request an urgent block. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停止担当へつなぎます。カードの種類とお名前をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will connect you to the blocking staff. Please give the card type and your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: キャッシュカードです。名義は山田健です。番号は財布の中で分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カード種類名義と番号不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a cash card. The name is Ken Yamada. I do not know the number because it is in the wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the card type, account-holder name and unknown number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号不明でもそのまま担当へお伝えください。登録した電話はお使いになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell the staff the number is unknown too. Can you use your registered phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、この携帯です。さっき残高を見たら、知らない引き出しがありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 登録電話の利用と不明な出金を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, this mobile. When I checked my balance just now, there was a withdrawal I did not recognize.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm access to your registered phone and report an unfamiliar withdrawal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その取引の時刻と金額も担当へ伝えましょう。通帳はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also give the transaction time and amount to the staff. Do you have your bankbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家にあります。今は停止を先にお願いして、取引の画面を保存します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 停止を優先し取引記録を残すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is at home. I want the block done first now, and I will save the transaction screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize blocking and keeping a transaction record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。再発行については停止の確認後に別途ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will explain reissue separately after confirming the block.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず停止と知らない引き出しの相談をお願いします。再発行はその後に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止と出金相談を依頼し再発行を後にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please start with the block and consultation about the unfamiliar withdrawal. I will ask about reissue afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request blocking and withdrawal consultation, leaving reissue until later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この電話を担当へおつなぎします。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will connect this call to the staff, then. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの商品についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the product you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った米を開けたら、小さな虫がいました。残りは袋に入れたままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 開封した米の異常と残品を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I opened rice bought yesterday, there were small insects. The rest is still in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a problem in opened rice and the remaining product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご不便をおかけしました。購入のレシートはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We are sorry for the inconvenience. Do you have the purchase receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。五キロの袋で、今朝初めて開けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入証明と開封時点を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. It is a five-kilogram bag, first opened this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the purchase evidence and when it was opened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品担当が現物と袋の表示を確認します。お米はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Product staff will check the rice itself and the bag label. Have you brought the rice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 重いので今日は袋の写真だけです。持ってくるまで、口を閉じて置いておけばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現物未持参を伝え保管方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is heavy, so today I only have photos of the bag. Should I keep the opening closed until bringing it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not brought the product and ask about storage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中身が出ないようにし、担当から扱い方をご案内します。連絡先をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep the contents from spilling out; the staff will explain how to handle it. Please give contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この番号です。家には同じ米がもう一袋あるので、そちらの番号も写真に撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先と別の未開封袋を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This number. I have one more bag of the same rice at home, so I will photograph its number too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give contact details and mention another unopened bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 製造番号が読める写真をお願いします。返金か交換かは確認後にご相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please provide photos with the production number readable. We will discuss refund or exchange after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。二袋の番号を送って、現物を持参する日時を担当と決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二袋の番号提出と現物持参の調整を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will send both bags' numbers and arrange with the staff when to bring the product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to submit both bag numbers and arrange bringing the rice itself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass this to the staff. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 海側の遊歩道をご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you use the seaside walking path?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 岬の方まで歩きたいです。この細い道は帰りも通れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 低い海沿い道の帰路利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to walk toward the cape. Can I use this narrow path on the return too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about using the low seaside path on the return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 海沿いの低い部分は、今日は午後に閉鎖します。今から往復されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The low part by the sea closes this afternoon. Will you make the round trip from now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼を食べてから戻る予定です。それだと閉鎖に間に合わないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰る時間と閉鎖の問題を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I plan to return after lunch. In that case I would not make it before closure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the return time and the closure problem. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 上の遊歩道なら帰りも通れます。岬まで少し遠回りになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The upper path can be used on the return too. It is a slight detour to the cape.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上の道には、途中で腰を下ろせる場所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 上の道の休憩場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is there anywhere to sit down along the upper path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about resting places on the upper path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展望広場にベンチがあります。そこから岬までは十分ほどです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are benches at the lookout square. The cape is about ten minutes from there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では低い道は使わず、上の道で広場までにします。風は強いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 短い経路に変更し風を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will avoid the low path and only go as far as the square on the upper path. Is the wind strong?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Change to a shorter route and ask about wind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 広場は風を受けやすいです。手前の東屋なら屋根と壁があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The square is exposed to wind. The shelter before it has a roof and walls.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 東屋で休んで、風が強ければそこから戻ります。道の入口を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 東屋を折返し候補にして入口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will rest in the shelter and return from there if the wind is strong. Please show the path entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Make the shelter a possible turning point and ask the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 管理棟の裏から続いています。どうぞよい散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: The path continues from behind the administration building. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss tickets, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日出発して日曜に帰ります。往復で買いたいのですが、帰りの日付も指定しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復券の帰りの日付指定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I leave tomorrow and return Sunday. I want a round-trip ticket; do I specify the return date too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about specifying a return date on a round-trip ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 指定する券と、期間内に使う券があります。帰りの列車は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Some tickets specify it; others are usable within a period. Have you decided your return train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日曜の夕方に帰りたいですが、時刻はまだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰りの日と時刻未定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want Sunday evening, but have not decided the time yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the return day and undecided time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 帰りの座席を指定しなければ、こちらの往復券が候補です。区間はこちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Without a reserved return seat, this round-trip ticket is an option. Is this the route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、山里駅までです。有効期間の最後は何曜日ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 区間と有効期間の最終日を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, to Yamazato Station. What day is the last day of validity?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the route and last valid day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この券では日曜までです。月曜に延びる可能性はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This ticket is valid until Sunday. Is there a chance of extending to Monday?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありません。帰りは普通列車にして、日曜中に使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日曜の普通列車利用を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I will return on a local train and use it within Sunday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to use a local train on Sunday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、この区間の往復券ですね。帰りの分は切り離して保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: A round-trip ticket for this route, then. Detach and keep the return part.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 行きと帰りを分けて財布に入れます。この往復券を一人分ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往復券一人分を購入し分けて保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the outward and return parts separately in my wallet. One round-trip ticket for one person, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy a round trip for one and keep the parts separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 発行しました。よいご旅行を。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてご用件を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me about the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車の税金の通知が来ました。でも、この番号の車はもう売っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 売却済みの車への税通知を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a vehicle-tax notice. But I have already sold the vehicle with this number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult about a tax notice for a vehicle already sold. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知と、売却した時の書類をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the notice and the sale documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通知はあります。売却の控えは家ですが、二月に店へ渡しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知の持参と売却時期を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the notice. The sale copy is at home, but I handed the vehicle to the shop in February.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the notice and when the vehicle was sold. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 税の担当が登録状況と日付を確認します。納期限はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tax staff will check registration and dates. When is the payment deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今月末です。事情を調べている間も、払う必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限と照会中の支払い扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The end of this month. Must I pay while the circumstances are being checked too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the deadline and ask about payment during the inquiry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 支払いの扱いは担当が説明しますので、期限も一緒にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will explain payment handling; please tell them the deadline too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。売った店の名前と電話番号も控えて持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 売却先の情報も用意すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will also note the name and phone number of the shop I sold it to and bring them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare the buyer's information too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は通知を見せて相談を始められます。担当の窓口は奥です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can show the notice and begin consultation today. The staff counter is farther in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日まず期限の扱いを相談して、売却書類は必要な部分を聞いてから持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日期限を相談し追加資料を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will first ask how the deadline is handled. I will ask which parts of the sale documents are needed before bringing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Consult on the deadline today and check additional documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの順番札をお取りください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take a queue ticket here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。紹介状がありますが、封を開けていなくて、どの科か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紹介状があり診療科が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have a referral letter, but have not opened the envelope and do not know the department.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have a referral but do not know the department. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒の宛先を拝見できますか。予約はお取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see the addressee on the envelope? Do you have an appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この封筒です。予約はなく、紹介した先生に午前中に来るよう言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約なしと紹介元の指示を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This envelope. No appointment; the referring doctor told me to come in the morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain no appointment and the referring doctor's instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外来担当に受付の可否を確認します。今気になる症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check acceptance with outpatient staff. Do you have symptoms concerning you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日より息切れが強くなっています。入口から歩くのもつらかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 息切れ悪化と歩行困難を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My shortness of breath is worse than yesterday. Even walking from the entrance was difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report worsening shortness of breath and difficulty walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 息切れの様子を確認します。ここにお掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check your breathing. Please sit here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。立って並ばず、この椅子で待っていていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 座ったまま待てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Can I wait in this chair rather than standing in line?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to wait while seated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、座ったままで結構です。医師へ症状を伝えるので、お名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, stay seated. We will tell the doctor your symptoms; please give your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 佐藤洋子です。紹介状はお渡しします。症状のことを先に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名と紹介状を渡し症状相談を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yoko Sato. I will hand over the referral. I want to discuss the symptoms first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your name and referral, prioritizing symptom consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ここでお加減を確認し、医師へ引き継ぎます。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check how you are here and hand over to the doctor. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾われた免許証をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought the driver's license you found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。駐車場の係の人に拾ったことを話したら、持ち主らしい人が私のところへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得後に持ち主を名乗る人が現れたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. When I told the parking attendant I found it, someone who seemed to be the owner came to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say someone claiming ownership appeared after the find. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 免許証は、その方に渡したのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you give that person the license?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 渡していません。名前は同じでしたが、写真と顔が違うように見えたので、ここへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未返却と写真の違和感を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. The name was the same, but the face seemed different from the photo, so I brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you did not return it and the photo seemed different. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで持ち主を確認します。その方から連絡先を聞かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will confirm ownership. Did that person ask for contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話番号だけ聞かれましたが、教えていません。「兄の免許証だ」と言っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連絡先未提供と兄の物との説明を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They only asked my phone number, but I did not give it. They said it was their older brother's license.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report you gave no contact details and the explanation that it was the brother's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのお話も記録します。拾った場所へ戻って手渡す約束はしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record that too. Did you promise to return to the finding location and hand it over?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 約束していません。ただ、係の人に警察へ届けると伝えておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却約束なしと駐車場への届け先連絡を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I did not promise. But I want to tell the attendant I am handing it to the police.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say no handover promise was made and ask about notifying parking staff where it was handed in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 免許証はこちらでお預かりします。係の方には届け先だけ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will keep the license. Tell the attendant only where you handed it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。本人確認と返却はお任せします。駐車場には、この警察署へ届けたと知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人確認を警察へ任せ施設に届け先を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I leave identity checking and return to you. I will tell parking staff I handed it to this police station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave identity checks to police and tell the facility where it was handed in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお預かりしました。お届けありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received it. Thank you for handing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居のお届けについてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about your change-of-address notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 転送を申し込んだのに、旧姓で届く郵便が前の家に残っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧姓宛ての郵便が転送されなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I applied for forwarding, but mail addressed to my former surname remained at the old home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report mail under your former surname was not forwarded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込みに書いたお名前は、現在のお名前だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you enter only your current name on the application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、今の名字だけです。旧姓で届くものも転送してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 届出名義と旧姓分の希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, only the current surname. I want mail under the old surname forwarded too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the application name and request for the old surname. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 旧姓の郵便を扱えるか、受付担当が申込内容を確認します。旧住所の控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Reception staff will check the application to see about handling the old surname. Do you have a copy of the old address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この控えがあります。前の家に住む人が、郵便を渡してくれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧住所控えと受領の経緯を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have this copy. The person living in the old home gave me the mail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the old-address copy and explain how you received the mail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 届いた封筒もあれば、宛名の確認に役立ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The envelopes that arrived will also help check the addressee if you have them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二通持ってきました。送り主にも新しい住所と名字を知らせた方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒を提示し送り主への変更通知を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I brought two. I should also tell the senders my new address and surname, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the envelopes and consider notifying senders of the changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、今後の発送先を変更してもらうと確実です。こちらの受付番号もお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, changing future mailing details is more reliable. Please also give the staff this reference number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えと封筒を担当に見せて、旧姓分の扱いを相談します。送り主には今日連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当への資料提示と発送元連絡を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the copy and envelopes and discuss the old surname's handling. I will contact the senders today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to show the staff documents and contact the senders. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当はこちらです。ご来局ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28225-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff are here. Thank you for visiting the post office.
